items.title: Galaxy Abandons BTC Bottom Call, Warns Bear Market Is Far From Over
items.summary: Galaxy Digital retracts its October bottom call, warning that bitcoin's bear market isn't over after breaking below key 50- and 200-week MAs.

items.title: Fidelity Pushes Beyond Bitcoin With Chainlink ETF Filing
items.summary: Fidelity Investments has filed with the SEC to launch a spot Chainlink ETF, expanding its crypto ETFs beyond bitcoin, ethereum, and solana.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
items.summary: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

items.title: Switzerland's First Spot Bitcoin ETF Hits SIX With 350 BTC
items.summary: Switzerland's first spot bitcoin ETF, BBIT, debuts on SIX with 350 BTC, a 0.19% annual fee, segregated Swiss custody and FINMA approval.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Taps $61K on Thanksgiving as Short Sellers Take a Beating
items.summary: BTC reclaimed $61K on Thanksgiving as short liquidations topped $117 million, but tariff threats and inflation concerns clouded the recovery.

items.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
items.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

items.title: US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Would Block BTC Sales for 20 Years

items.title: Bitcoin's dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
items.summary: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $3.05B in 7 Days as November Outflows Hit $5.39B
items.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $453.12 million on Wednesday, extending their seven-day withdrawal streak to $3.05 billion.

items.title: JPMorgan says bitcoin 'capitulation' signaled by Strategy's record-low NAV multiple
items.summary: JPMorgan analysts said Strategy's valuation relative to its bitcoin holdings has hit a record low, signaling bitcoin "capitulation."
